question: In the November 2025 bye-elections, which of the following political parties won the bye-election from Nagrota (Jammu & Kashmir)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** secured a significant victory in the **Nagrota** Assembly constituency during the bye-elections held in **November 2025**.
 
• The **Nagrota** seat, located in the **Jammu district** of the Union Territory of **Jammu & Kashmir**, is considered a high-profile constituency due to its strategic and political importance in the **Jammu region**.
 
• Bye-elections are conducted by the **Election Commission of India (ECI)** to fill a vacancy that arises before the expiration of the full term of the legislative body, often due to the **death**, **resignation**, or **disqualification** of the sitting representative.
 
• In this specific contest, the **BJP** candidate managed to consolidate a majority of the votes, defeating rivals from the **Indian National Congress (INC)** and regional parties like the **People's Democratic Party (PDP)**.
 
• The victory in **Nagrota** further strengthened the **BJP's** position in the **Jammu and Kashmir Legislative Assembly**, reflecting the party's continued influence in the **Jammu division**. ***Hence, the correct answer is the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP).***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Political Landscape of Jammu & Kashmir:**
 
 
• Since the **abrogation of Article 370** in **August 2019**, **Jammu & Kashmir** was reorganized into a **Union Territory** with a **Legislative Assembly**.
 
• The political arena is characterized by a mix of national parties like the **BJP** and **INC**, and regional parties such as the **National Conference (NC)** and the **People's Democratic Party (PDP)**.
 
 
 
• **Nagrota Constituency:**
 
 
• **Nagrota** is a key town and a tehsil in the **Jammu district**. It is also home to a major **Indian Army** corps headquarters, making it a sensitive and prominent location.
 
• The constituency has historically seen intense competition between the **BJP** and the **National Conference**.
 
 
 
• **Election Commission of India (ECI):**
 
 
• The **ECI** is an autonomous constitutional authority responsible for administering election processes in India at the national, state, and district levels.
 
• Under **Article 324** of the **Constitution of India**, the **ECI** has the power of superintendence, direction, and control of elections.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Bye-elections:**
 
 
• Bye-elections, or **By-polls**, serve as a barometer for the popularity of the ruling party and the opposition between general elections.
 
• They are mandated by the **Representation of the People Act, 1951**, which stipulates that a bye-election must be held within **six months** of the occurrence of the vacancy, provided the remainder of the term is not less than **one year**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **Representation of the People Act, 1951**: This act contains provisions for the conduct of elections, the **qualifications and disqualifications** for membership of the Houses, and the **procedure for settling doubts and disputes** arising out of elections.
 
• **Voter Turnout**: Bye-elections in **Jammu & Kashmir** often witness varying levels of voter participation, influenced by the prevailing **security situation** and **socio-political climate** of the region.
 
• **Electoral Rolls**: The update of **electoral rolls** is a crucial step taken by the **ECI** before any election to ensure all eligible citizens can exercise their **franchise**.
